scoring_path.scope_note: Absolute scores are not comparable with live assessments: domain intelligence, link-following policy checks and visual analysis are excluded so that two variants of one fixture differ only in their bytes. Every claim below is a within-pair comparison.

detection.definition: predicted positive when the assessment carries ['encoded_instruction_blob', 'hidden_prompt_injection']

obfuscation_counterfactual.note: Keyword matching is fragile to zero-width and bidi obfuscation: normalising the hidden channels before matching would recover these cases, which quantifies the gap rather than hiding it.

score_invariance.definition: For each hidden-channel pair, re-score the injected page after dropping the injection-related evidence codes ['bidi_control_spoofing', 'encoded_instruction_blob', 'hidden_prompt_injection', 'zero_width_obfuscation'] and compare with the baseline page. Exact invariance means identical overall risk, identical per-dimension scores and the same guard verdict, so the only thing a hidden instruction changed is the evidence recorded about it.

injection_contribution.note: The overall jump can exceed the evidence risk points because a HIGH-severity finding also applies a score floor. Both are documented, neither is the instruction being followed.

obedience_check.definition: If the engine obeyed the injected instruction, hidden text would raise trust points or lower risk. Both must be impossible.

limitations: Fixtures are locally authored, so they measure the detector, not real-world prevalence.
Scoring excludes network enrichment, so absolute levels are lower than live assessments.
The natural prevalence of hidden injection content in the crawled corpus is measured separately in data/research/profile_feed_v2.json.
